portrait_soft_keyboard.evidence: Visible keyboard and focused command field after starting a new Android system shell.

command_entry_and_execution.method: ADB injected text into the focused application command field, then tapped its Run button. Echo marker appeared in the native terminal.

touch_scrollback.method: ADB injected slow touch swipe inside terminal output

landscape_output_and_controls.evidence: Live 120-row terminal output and full command row rendered in a 2712 x 1220 capture with keyboard closed.

scope: Installed Companion 0.3.1 only. These results do not establish acceptance of newer CI artifacts, production signing, remote pairing or all input methods.
